RECIPES.title: Rachel's Rigatoni with Broccoli
RECIPES.subtitle: and Garlic Bread Croutons

proteinOptions.name: Antibiotic Free Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast

beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Bring 8 cups water and 2 tsp. salt to a boil in a medium pot

steps.title: Cook Pasta and Prepare Ingredients
bullets: Once water is boiling, add pasta and cook until al dente, 11-13 minutes.
Remove from burner. Reserve ¾ cup pasta cooking water. Drain pasta in a colander/strainer and set aside.
While pasta cooks, cut broccoli into bite-sized pieces.
Cut ciabatta into 1" dice.
Trim and thinly slice green onions, keeping white and green portions separate.
Mince garlic.

steps.title: Toast the Garlic Bread Croutons
bullets: Place a large non-stick pan over medium heat and add 1 Tbsp. olive oil.
Add half the garlic (reserve remaining for sauce) to hot pan and stir occasionally until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add ciabatta and a pinch of salt. Stir occasionally until golden-brown, 2-4 minutes.
Remove from burner.

steps.title: Cook the Broccoli
bullets: Place a medium non-stick pan over medium heat and add 2 tsp. olive oil.
Add broccoli and ¼ cup water to hot pan. Cover and cook until water is almost completely evaporated, 4-6 minutes.
Uncover and stir occasionally until tender, 2-3 minutes.
Transfer broccoli to a plate. Wipe pan clean and keep over medium heat.

steps.title: Make the Sauce
bullets: Add 2 tsp. olive oil, remaining garlic, and white portions of green onions to hot pan. Stir occasionally until garlic is fragrant, 30-60 seconds.
Add flour and stir often until no dry flour remains.
Add cream base, ¼ cup reserved pasta cooking water, and mirepoix base. Stir occasionally until combined and sauce is slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes.
If too thick, add additional reserved pasta cooking water, 1 Tbsp. at a time, until desired consistency is reached.

steps.title: Add Pasta and Finish Dish
bullets: Add pasta, broccoli, cheese, and ¼ tsp. salt to hot pan. Stir often until coated and cheese has melted, 1-2 minutes.
Remove from burner.
Plate dish as pictured on front of card, topping pasta with croutons. Garnish with green portions of green onions. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.notes: Doubled the garlic and it was better for it. Croutons go soggy fast — add them at the table, not in the pan.

RECIPES.title: Chicken Verde Soup
RECIPES.subtitle: with tomatillos, poblanos, and cilantro
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat
Remove all produce from any packaging, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry

steps.title: Prepare the Ingredients
bullets: Remove husks from tomatillos, rinse, and dice into ½" pieces.
Stem and chop cilantro.
Stem poblano, seed, and dice into ¼" pieces.
Pat chicken dry and season with ¼ tsp. salt, a pinch of pepper, and half the fiesta seasoning.

steps.title: Cook the Vegetables
bullets: Place a medium pot over medium heat and add 2 tsp. olive oil.
Add poblanos, tomatillos, remaining fiesta seasoning, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Stir occasionally until tender, 9-11 minutes.

steps.title: Add the Chicken
bullets: Add 1 tsp. olive oil and chicken to pot.
Stir occasionally until golden-brown and chicken reaches 165 degrees internally, 5-7 minutes.

steps.title: Mash the Beans
bullets: Drain and rinse beans in a colander/strainer.
Place in a mixing bowl and mash until slightly chunky.

steps.title: Finish the Soup and Finish Dish
bullets: Add chicken base, salsa, corn, beans, 2 cups water, and a pinch of salt to pot. Stir and bring to a simmer.
Stir occasionally until slightly thickened, 4-6 minutes. Remove from burner.
Plate dish and top with cilantro and sour cream. Bon appétit!
