RECIPES.title: Grandma’s Lemon Meringue Pie
RECIPES.subtitle: one 9-inch pie
beforeYouCook: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C)
Have the pie crust baked and cooled before you start the filling

steps.title: Gather and Preheat
bullets: Gather all ingredients and preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C).

steps.title: Start the Lemon Filling
bullets: Whisk 1 cup sugar, flour, cornstarch, and salt together in a medium saucepan; stir in water, lemon juice, and lemon zest.
Cook over medium-high heat, stirring frequently, until mixture comes to a boil. Stir in butter.

steps.title: Temper the Yolks
bullets: Place egg yolks in a small bowl and gradually whisk in 1/2 cup of hot sugar mixture.

steps.title: Thicken and Fill
bullets: Whisk egg yolk mixture back into remaining sugar mixture.
Bring to a boil and continue to cook while stirring constantly until thick.
Remove from heat; pour filling into prepared baked pie crust.

steps.title: Make the Meringue
bullets: Beat egg whites in a glass, metal, or ceramic bowl with an electric mixer until foamy.
Gradually add sugar, continuing to beat until stiff peaks form.

steps.title: Top the Pie
bullets: Working quickly, spread meringue over pie filling, sealing the edges at the crust.
Use the back of the spoon to create peaks on the top of the meringue if you like.

steps.title: Bake
bullets: Bake pie in the preheated oven until meringue is golden brown, about 20 to 25 minutes.

steps.title: Cool and Chill
bullets: Remove pie from oven and cool at room temperature for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Transfer to the refrigerator, uncovered, and chill for a minimum of 2 hours before slicing.

steps.title: Serve
bullets: Serve and enjoy! Store any leftovers in the refrigerator and consume within 2 days.

RECIPES.title: Steak with Bacon Wedge Salad
RECIPES.subtitle: and cheese-filled cornbread muffins
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Move oven rack to middle position

steps.title: Make the Cornbread Muffin Batter and Cheese Filling
bullets: In a mixing bowl, combine corn muffin mix and 1/3 cup water. Stir until a thick batter forms. Set aside.
In another mixing bowl, combine softened cream cheese, shredded cheese, and half the smoked paprika (remaining is yours to use as you please!). Set aside.

steps.title: Assemble and Bake the Cornbread Muffins
bullets: Evenly divide cornbread muffin batter among 4 cups in prepared muffin tin. Cups should be filled about halfway.
Evenly divide cheese filling among cups, placing in center of batter.
Bake in hot oven until slightly browned and starting to crack, 14-17 minutes.
Carefully remove from oven.
While cornbread muffins bake, continue recipe.

steps.title: Crisp Bacon and Prepare Ingredients
bullets: Line a microwave-safe plate with a paper towel. Spread bacon evenly on towel-lined plate. Microwave until crisp, 1-2 minutes.
Carefully remove from microwave.
While bacon microwaves, remove any outer or discolored leaves of lettuce. Cut into quarters to create 4 wedges.
Quarter tomatoes. Season all over with a pinch of salt and pepper. If you receive one whole tomato instead, not to worry; simply core tomato, cut into 1/2" dice, and proceed with recipe instructions.
Pat steaks dry. Season both sides with a pinch of salt and pepper.

steps.title: Cook the Steaks
bullets: Summertime, and the grilling is easy! To grill these steaks, heat grill to medium. Follow same instructions, grilling until browned and steak reaches a minimum internal temperature of 145 degrees, 4-6 minutes per side.
Place a medium non-stick pan over medium heat and add 2 tsp. olive oil. Add steaks to hot pan. Cook until steaks reach desired doneness, or 4-6 minutes per side for medium/medium-well.
Steak thickness can vary; if you receive a thinner steak, we recommend checking for doneness sooner.
Transfer steaks to a plate and cover with foil. Rest, 3 minutes. Keep pan over medium heat; no need to wipe clean.

steps.title: Make Sauce and Finish Dish
bullets: Add mushroom base and 2 Tbsp. water to hot pan. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Once simmering, stir in 1 Tbsp. butter and mustard (to taste) until combined, 30-60 seconds.
Remove from burner and stir in a pinch of pepper until combined.

Plate dish as pictured on front of card, topping steak with sauce. Slice steak, if desired. Garnish two lettuce wedges with ranch dressing, tomatoes, then bacon. Top two cornbread muffins with 1/2 Tbsp. softened butter. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Spinach Artichoke-Stuffed Chicken
RECIPES.subtitle: with green beans almondine
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 425 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes

steps.title: Prepare the Ingredients
bullets: Halve lemon lengthwise. Cut one half into wedges and juice the other half.
Trim ends off green beans, if necessary.
Coarsely chop spinach.
Coarsely chop artichokes.

steps.title: Prepare the Chicken
bullets: In a mixing bowl, thoroughly combine softened cream cheese, 2 tsp. lemon juice, spinach, artichokes, Parmesan, a pinch of salt, and 1/4 tsp. pepper.

Pat chicken dry and place on a clean cutting board. Using a sharp knife, make a lengthwise cut in the thickest end of chicken breast. Cut should be deep enough to stuff with spinach-artichoke mixture. Repeat with second chicken breast.
Fill chicken evenly with spinach-artichoke mixture. If chicken breast is misshapen, gently press to flatten. Season one side with garlic pepper.

steps.title: Cook the Chicken
bullets: Place a medium oven-safe non-stick pan over medium-high heat and add 2 tsp. olive oil.
Add chicken to hot pan, garlic pepper-side down. Cook until browned, 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove from burner. Transfer pan to hot oven and roast until chicken reaches a minimum internal temperature of 165 degrees, 10-12 minutes.
While chicken cooks, continue recipe.

steps.title: Cook the Green Beans
bullets: Place a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat and add 2 tsp. olive oil.
Add green beans to hot pan and stir occasionally, 1 minute.
Add 1/4 cup water, 1/4 tsp. salt, and a pinch of pepper. Cover, and stir occasionally until tender, 6-8 minutes.
If green beans need more time, add 2 Tbsp. water and stir occasionally, 1-3 minutes.
Remove from burner. Stir in softened butter and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Finish the Dish
bullets: Plate dish as pictured on front of card, topping green beans with almonds. Squeeze lemon wedges over green beans to taste. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Candied Bacon and Smoked Gouda Beef Burger
RECIPES.subtitle: with fries
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 450 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes

steps.title: Roast the Fries
bullets: Cut potatoes into 1/4"-thick fries and pat dry.
Place fries on prepared baking sheet and toss with 1 tsp. olive oil and a pinch of salt and pepper. Spread into a single layer.
Roast in hot oven until lightly browned, 25-30 minutes, tossing once halfway through.
While fries roast, continue recipe.

steps.title: Prepare the Tomatoes
bullets: Coarsely chop tomatoes.

steps.title: Toast Rolls and Cook Patties
bullets: Form ground beef into two equally-sized patties, about 5" in diameter. Season both sides with 1/4 tsp. salt and a pinch of pepper.
Place a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add rolls to hot, dry pan, cut-side down, and toast until lightly browned, 3-5 minutes.
Remove from burner and transfer to a plate. Keep pan over medium-high heat.
Add patties to hot, dry pan. Cook until lightly charred and patties reach a minimum internal temperature of 160 degrees, 4-6 minutes per side.
Remove from burner. Top patties with cheese. Cover and let melt, 1-2 minutes.
While patties cook, continue recipe.

steps.title: Make the Candied Bacon
bullets: Place a small non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add bacon to hot, dry pan. Stir often until browned, 2-3 minutes.
Add brown sugar and 2 tsp. water. Stir often until water is almost entirely evaporated, 2-3 minutes.
Hot bacon alert! Keep an eye on pan as bacon may burn easily.
Remove from burner and transfer bacon to a plate.

steps.title: Finish the Dish
bullets: Plate dish as pictured on front of card, topping bottom roll with mayonnaise, tomatoes, patty, candied bacon, and top roll. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Steak Strip Marsala Risotto
RECIPES.subtitle: with Parmesan, tomatoes, and mushrooms
beforeYouCook: Bring 4 cups water to a boil in a medium pot
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry

steps.title: Prepare the Ingredients
bullets: Cut mushrooms into 1/4" slices.
Core tomato and cut into 1/4" dice.
Trim and thinly slice green onions.
Pat steak strips dry, and season all over with pot roast seasoning.
If using flank steak, follow same instructions. If using ground beef, combine with pot roast seasoning.

steps.title: Start the Risotto
bullets: Place another medium pot over medium-high heat and add 2 tsp. olive oil.
Add rice and half the green onions (reserve remaining for mushrooms). Stir occasionally until rice is toasted, 1-2 minutes.

steps.title: Finish the Risotto
bullets: Add 1 cup boiling water and 1/4 tsp. salt to pot with rice. Rice should just be covered by water. Stir often until nearly all water is absorbed.
Add 1/2 cup boiling water and stir often until nearly all water is absorbed. Repeat this process, stirring often, 18-20 minutes.
Taste risotto as you cook, checking for tenderness. When rice has no more “bite” or crunch, it's done. There may be water left.
Remove from burner. Add Parmesan (reserve a pinch for garnish) and stir to combine. Cover and set aside.

steps.title: Sear the Steak
bullets: Place a large non-stick pan over high heat and add 2 tsp. olive oil. Add steak strips to hot pan and stir occasionally until browned, 2-4 minutes.
Remove steaks strips to a plate. Keep pan over high heat.
If using flank steak or ground beef, follow same instructions.

steps.title: Cook Mushrooms and Finish Dish
bullets: Add 2 tsp. olive oil, mushrooms, 1/4 tsp. salt, and a pinch of pepper to hot pan. Stir occasionally until browned, 4-5 minutes.

Add Marsala wine, beef demi-glace, 1/4 cup water, tomatoes, remaining green onions (reserve a pinch for garnish), steak strips and any accumulated juices, and a pinch of salt. Stir until warmed through, 3-4 minutes.
Plate dish as pictured on front of card, topping risotto with steak strips and mushrooms and garnishing with reserved Parmesan and green onions. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Brown Butter and Sage Gnocchi
RECIPES.subtitle: with candied walnuts
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 425 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes

steps.title: Roast the Butternut Squash
bullets: Halve any large butternut squash pieces to roughly match smaller pieces.
Place butternut squash on prepared baking sheet and toss with 1 tsp. olive oil. Spread into a single layer.
Roast in hot oven until tender, 25-30 minutes, tossing once halfway through.
While butternut squash roasts, continue recipe.

steps.title: Crisp the Sage
bullets: Line a plate with a paper towel.
Stem sage.
Place a medium non-stick pan over medium heat and add 1 tsp. olive oil. Add sage leaves to hot pan and stir constantly until crispy and slightly darkened, 1-2 minutes.
Remove from burner. Transfer to towel-lined plate. Rest, 3 minutes.
Wipe pan clean and reserve.
Once cool enough to handle, finely chop.

steps.title: Candy the Walnuts
bullets: Coarsely chop walnuts.
Return pan used to crisp sage to medium heat. Add sugar to hot pan and let melt, 30-60 seconds.
Add walnuts, stirring occasionally until coated, 30-45 seconds.
Remove from burner. Transfer to another plate and let cool, 5 minutes.
Wipe pan clean and reserve.

steps.title: Brown the Butter
bullets: Return pan used to candy walnuts to medium heat and add butter to hot pan.
Stir occasionally until butter smells "nutty," turns golden, and brown flecks appear, 4-6 minutes.
Remove from burner.

steps.title: Cook Gnocchi, Add Sauce, and Finish Dish
bullets: Place a large non-stick pan over medium heat and add 1 Tbsp. olive oil.
Add gnocchi to hot pan and stir occasionally until tender and golden-brown, 5-7 minutes.

Add butternut squash, brown butter, cream base, mirepoix base, half the cheese (reserve remaining for garnish), 2 Tbsp. water, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Stir occasionally until sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes.
If sauce is too thick, add additional water, 1 tsp. at a time, until desired consistency is reached. Remove from burner.
After 5 minutes, or once cool enough to handle, in a mixing bowl, combine walnuts and sage.
Plate dish as pictured on front of card, topping gnocchi with walnut-sage mixture and remaining cheese. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Mexicali Cheesy Penne
RECIPES.subtitle: with corn and poblano
beforeYouCook: Bring 8 cups water and 2 tsp. salt to a boil in a medium pot
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry

steps.title: Cook the Pasta
bullets: Once water is boiling, add pasta and cook until al dente, 10-12 minutes.
Reserve 1/4 cup pasta cooking water. Drain pasta in a colander and return to pot to keep warm. Set aside.
While pasta cooks, prepare ingredients.

steps.title: Prepare the Ingredients
bullets: Trim and thinly slice green onions on an angle.
Halve tomatoes.

Stem poblano pepper, seed, halve lengthwise, and slice into thick strips. Poblano peppers can vary in spice level; most are mild, but a few can be quite hot. Wash hands and cutting board after prepping.

steps.title: Cook the Vegetables
bullets: Place a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add 1 tsp. olive oil, corn, poblano (to taste), green onions (reserving a pinch for garnish), taco seasoning, 1/4 tsp. salt, and a pinch of pepper to hot pan. Stir occasionally until poblano and corn are brown and tender, 4-6 minutes.

Meat lovers! If using chicken, pat dry and season all over with 1/4 tsp. salt and a pinch of pepper. Stir occasionally with 2 tsp. olive oil in a medium non-stick pan over medium-high heat until chicken reaches a minimum internal temperature of 165 degrees, 5-7 minutes. If using shrimp, pat dry. Cook with 1 tsp. olive oil in a medium non-stick pan over medium-high heat until shrimp reaches a minimum internal temperature of 145 degrees, 2-3 minutes per side. If using ground pork, combine with 1/4 tsp. salt and a pinch of pepper. Cook with 1 tsp. olive oil in a medium non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Break into small pieces with a spoon until no pink remains, 5-7 minutes.

steps.title: Make the Sauce
bullets: Add cream, reserved pasta cooking water, cheese, pasta, tomatoes, sour cream, and 1/4 tsp. salt to pan. Stir constantly until cheese melts, 1-2 minutes.
Remove from burner.
If using protein, stir into pasta.

steps.title: Finish the Dish
bullets: Plate dish as pictured on front of card, garnishing with crispy jalapeños (to taste) and reserved green onions. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Crispy Garlic Chicken
RECIPES.subtitle: with Dijon green bean salad
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry

steps.title: Prepare and Chill the Green Beans
bullets: Trim green beans, if necessary, and cut into 1" pieces.
In a microwave-safe bowl, combine green beans, 2 tsp. olive oil, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Microwave uncovered until green beans are bright green and fork-tender, 4-6 minutes.
Carefully remove from microwave. Drain any excess liquid and transfer to refrigerator. Let chill, 10 minutes.
While green beans microwave and chill, continue recipe.

steps.title: Prepare the Chicken
bullets: Evenly spread breadcrumbs on a plate.
Pat chicken dry. Season both sides with half the garlic salt (remaining is yours to use as you please!) and a pinch of pepper.
Evenly spread 1 tsp. dressing (reserve remaining for salad) on one side of chicken.
Place chicken, dressing-side down, onto plate with breadcrumbs, pressing gently to adhere.

steps.title: Cook the Chicken
bullets: Place a medium non-stick pan over medium heat and add 2 tsp. olive oil.
Add chicken, breadcrumb-side down, to hot pan. Cook until browned and chicken reaches a minimum internal temperature of 165 degrees, 5-7 minutes per side.
Remove from burner.
While chicken cooks, continue recipe.

steps.title: Prepare Lemon, Assemble Green Bean Salad, and Finish Dish
bullets: Zest and halve lemon. Cut halves into wedges.
After 10 minutes, carefully remove green beans from refrigerator. Stir in remaining dressing, 1 tsp. lemon zest, cabbage, arugula, cranberries, almonds, and a pinch of salt and pepper until combined.
Plate dish as pictured on front of card, squeezing lemon wedges over dish to taste. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Chicken Bacon Ranch Quesadilla
RECIPES.subtitle: with chives
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry

steps.title: Cook the Filling
bullets: Pat chicken dry and season all over with a pinch of salt and pepper. Halve any larger pieces to match smaller pieces.
Place a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat and add 2 tsp. olive oil.
Add chicken, corn, bacon, 1/4 tsp. salt, and 1/4 tsp. pepper to hot pan. Stir occasionally until chicken reaches a minimum internal temperature of 165 degrees, 5-7 minutes.
Remove from burner.
While filling cooks, continue recipe.

steps.title: Prepare Ingredients and Make Ranch
bullets: Core tomato and cut into 1/4" dice.
Mince chives.
In a mixing bowl, combine 1 Tbsp. water, creme fraiche, buttermilk-dill seasoning, and half the chives (reserve remaining for garnish). Set aside.

steps.title: Assemble the Quesadillas
bullets: Stir tomatoes into pan with filling.
Place tortillas on a clean, flat work surface.
Evenly divide half of both cheeses between tortillas, placing on one half. Evenly top cheese with filling, then remaining cheese.
Fold tortillas over cheese and filling, pressing gently to adhere.
Wipe pan clean and reserve.

steps.title: Cook Quesadillas and Finish Dish
bullets: Return pan used to cook filling to medium heat and add 1 Tbsp. olive oil.
Working in batches if necessary, add quesadillas to hot pan (there should be no overlap). Cook until golden-brown, 2-4 minutes per side.
Replenish oil, as necessary. Remove from burner.
Plate dish as pictured on front of card, halving quesadillas, if desired, and serving with remaining chives and ranch. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Weeknight Brown Sugar Beef Meatloaf
RECIPES.subtitle: with garlic butter broccoli and potatoes
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 425 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes

steps.title: Prepare the Potatoes
bullets: Cut potatoes into 1" pieces.
Place potatoes on prepared baking sheet. Add 1 tsp. olive oil, 1/4 tsp. salt, and garlic pepper. Massage oil and seasonings into potatoes and spread into an even layer on one half of sheet.

steps.title: Add the Meatloaf
bullets: In a mixing bowl, thoroughly combine ground beef, savory seasoning, 1/4 tsp. salt, ricotta, and panko. Form meat mixture into two equally-sized, oval-shaped loaves, about 3" in length and 2" by height. Place loaves on empty side of baking sheet and top evenly with 1 tsp. olive oil.
In another mixing bowl, combine ketchup and brown sugar. Set aside.

steps.title: Roast the Potatoes and Meatloaves and Add Broccoli
bullets: Roast in hot oven until potatoes and meatloaves are browned, 13-15 minutes.
Meatloaves will finish roasting in another step.
Carefully remove baking sheet from oven. Top meatloaves evenly with brown sugar-ketchup mixture. Push potatoes to one third of sheet. Sheet will be hot! Use a utensil.
Add broccoli to center of sheet. Top with 1 tsp. olive oil and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Roast Vegetables and Meatloaves and Finish Dish
bullets: Roast in hot oven until potatoes and broccoli are tender and meatloaves reach a minimum internal temperature of 160 degrees, 7-9 minutes.
Carefully remove from oven.
To serve, stir softened butter into potatoes and broccoli until melted and combined. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Pub-Style Crunchy Chicken
RECIPES.subtitle: with Brussels sprouts and cheddar potatoes
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 425 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes

steps.title: Start the Brussels Sprouts
bullets: Spray both provided trays with cooking spray.
In one provided tray, combine Brussels sprouts, half the garlic salt (reserve remaining for chicken), and 1 tsp. olive oil. Spread into a single layer.
Bake uncovered in hot oven until starting to brown, 10-12 minutes.

steps.title: Add the Potatoes and Chicken
bullets: Carefully remove tray from oven and push Brussels sprouts to one side of tray. Add potatoes, cream cheese, and shredded cheese to now-empty side of tray, stirring vigorously to combine. Cream cheese will melt as meal bakes. Spread into an even layer.
Coarsely crush crackers.
Pat chicken dry and season both sides with a pinch of pepper.
Combine crackers, remaining garlic salt, and 1 tsp. olive oil on a plate. Place chicken onto plate with cracker mixture and flip until coated on both sides, pressing gently to adhere.
Place chicken in second provided tray.

steps.title: Bake Meal and Make Sauce
bullets: Bake Brussels sprouts and potatoes uncovered in hot oven until tender and heated through, 8-12 minutes.
Bake chicken uncovered in hot oven until chicken reaches a minimum internal temperature of 165 degrees, 18-22 minutes.
While meal bakes, in a mixing bowl, combine garlic pepper, mustard, mayonnaise, and 1 tsp. water. Set aside.
Carefully remove both trays from oven. Vigorously stir mashed potatoes to combine.
To serve, top chicken with sauce. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Easy Sausage and Asiago Casserole
RECIPES.subtitle: with spinach and mushrooms
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 425 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes

steps.title: Start the Sausage and Mushrooms
bullets: Place sausage in provided tray and break up into bite-sized pieces. Stir in mushrooms until combined and spread into an even layer.
Bake uncovered in hot oven, 10 minutes.
Sausage will finish cooking in a later step.
While sausage and mushrooms bake, continue recipe.

steps.title: Add the Rice
bullets: Coarsely tear spinach.
Carefully massage rice in bag to break up any clumps.

After 10 minutes, carefully remove tray from oven. Stir in rice, spinach, red pepper flakes (use less if spice-averse), pesto, cream cheese, cream base, and a pinch of salt and pepper until combined. Spread into an even layer.

steps.title: Bake Meal and Plate Dish
bullets: Bake uncovered in hot oven until rice is heated through and sausage reaches a minimum internal temperature of 165 degrees, 12-15 minutes.
Carefully remove tray from hot oven and stir to combine. Tray will be hot! Use caution.
To serve, top with shredded cheese. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Honey Dijon Chicken Tenders
RECIPES.subtitle: with Sriracha fries
beforeYouCook: Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 450 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes
Prepare a baking sheet with foil and cooking spray

steps.title: Bake the Fries
bullets: Cut potatoes into 1/4" fries and pat dry.
Place fries on prepared baking sheet and toss with 1 Tbsp. olive oil and a pinch of salt. Massage oil and seasoning into potatoes.
Spread into a single layer and bake in hot oven until lightly browned, 25-28 minutes, tossing fries halfway through.
Carefully, remove fries to a mixing bowl and gently toss with Sriracha salt (to taste). Fries will be hot! Use a utensil.
While fries bake, continue recipe.

steps.title: Prepare Ingredients and Make Sauce
bullets: Crush crispy onions.
Trim and thinly slice green onions.
Combine honey and mustard in another mixing bowl. Set aside.
Pat chicken breasts dry and, on a separate cutting board, cut into 3/4" strips. Season all over with a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Prepare the Chicken
bullets: Place panko on a plate.
Combine tempura mix and 1/4 cup water in another mixing bowl until a thin batter forms, like a pancake batter. If too thick, add water, 1 tsp. at a time, until desired consistency is reached.

Transfer chicken pieces to tempura batter, coating each piece completely and evenly. Allow excess batter to drip off, and transfer chicken pieces to plate with panko. Flip pieces until coated entirely with panko, pressing gently to adhere.

steps.title: Cook the Chicken
bullets: Place a medium non-stick pan over medium heat and add canola oil. Heat oil, 3 minutes.
While oil heats, line a plate with a paper towel.
After 3 minutes, test oil temperature by adding a pinch of panko to it. It should sizzle gently. If it browns immediately, turn heat down and let oil cool. If it doesn't brown, increase heat.
Working in batches if necessary, lay chicken tenders in hot oil and flip occasionally until crispy, golden brown, and chicken reaches a minimum internal temperature of 165 degrees, 5-8 minutes.
Remove from burner. Transfer chicken to towel-lined plate.

steps.title: Finish the Dish
bullets: Plate dish as pictured on front of card, topping chicken with sauce, then crispy onions and green onions. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Basil Butter Chicken and Tomato Tortellini
RECIPES.subtitle: with Parmesan and chives
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry

steps.title: Prepare the Ingredients
bullets: Halve tomatoes. If you receive one whole tomato instead, not to worry; simply core tomato, cut into 1/2" dice, and proceed with recipe instructions.
Mince chives.
Pat chicken dry and season both sides with garlic pepper.

steps.title: Cook the Chicken
bullets: Place a medium non-stick pan over medium heat and add 2 tsp. olive oil.
Add chicken to hot pan. Cook until browned and chicken reaches a minimum internal temperature of 165 degrees, 5-7 minutes per side.
Remove from burner.
While chicken cooks, continue recipe.

steps.title: Cook the Tomatoes
bullets: Place a large non-stick pan over medium heat and add 1 tsp. olive oil.
Add tomatoes to hot pan. Stir often until slightly tender, 1-2 minutes.

steps.title: Add the Tortellini
bullets: Add tortellini, lemon n herb seasoning, and 1/2 cup water to hot pan. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Once simmering, cover and cook until water is almost completely evaporated, 3-5 minutes.

steps.title: Add Sauce and Finish Dish
bullets: Uncover; add cream base, sun dried tomato pesto, cheese, and a pinch of salt to hot pan. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Once simmering, stir occasionally until tortellini is tender, 1-2 minutes.
Remove from burner.
Plate dish as pictured on front of card, topping chicken with basil pesto butter. Slice chicken, if desired. Garnish dish with chives. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Beef & Butternut Squash Risotto
RECIPES.subtitle: with fig and blue cheese
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 425 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes

steps.title: Roast the Butternut Squash
bullets: Halve any large butternut squash pieces to roughly match smaller pieces.
Place butternut squash on prepared baking sheet and toss with 2 tsp. olive oil and savory seasoning. Spread into an even layer.
Roast in hot oven until tender, 20-25 minutes, tossing once halfway through.
Carefully remove from oven.
While butternut squash roasts, continue recipe.

steps.title: Prepare the Ingredients
bullets: Mince chives.
Pat steak strips dry. Coarsely chop, then separate pieces. Season all over with a pinch of salt and pepper.

steps.title: Start the Risotto
bullets: Place another medium pot over medium-high heat and add 1 tsp. olive oil.
Add rice to hot pot. Stir occasionally until rice is toasted and opaque, 1-2 minutes.
Add 1 cup boiling water from other pot, vegetable base, and 1/4 tsp. salt to pot with rice. Rice should just be covered by water. Stir often until nearly all water is absorbed.

steps.title: Finish the Risotto
bullets: Add 1/2 cup boiling water from other pot to hot pot with rice. Stir often until nearly all water is absorbed. Repeat this process, stirring often, 18-20 minutes.
Taste risotto as you cook, checking for tenderness. When rice has no more “bite” or crunch, it's done. There may be water left.
Remove from burner. Stir in roasted garlic & herb butter, shredded cheese, and 1/4 tsp. salt until combined. Set aside and cover to keep warm.

steps.title: Cook Steak Strips and Finish Dish
bullets: Place a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat and add 1 tsp. olive oil.
Add steak strips to hot pan. Stir occasionally until no pink remains and steak strips reach a minimum internal temperature of 145 degrees, 4-6 minutes.
Stir in 1 Tbsp. plain butter, beef base, and fig preserves until combined, 1-2 minutes.
Remove from burner. Rest, 3 minutes.
Plate dish as pictured on front of card, topping risotto with butternut squash and steak strips. Garnish with blue cheese (to taste), chives, and balsamic glaze (to taste). Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Scallops atop Truffled Mushroom Risotto
RECIPES.subtitle: with Sicilian sauce
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Bring 4 cups water to a boil in a medium pot

steps.title: Prepare the Ingredients
bullets: Cut mushrooms into 1/4" slices.
Mince chives.
Pat scallops dry. Season all over with a pinch of salt and pepper. Scallops will vary in amount as they are portioned by weight. Don't worry, the sweet flavor and tender texture will be the same.

steps.title: Cook the Mushrooms
bullets: Place a medium pot over medium heat and add 2 tsp. olive oil.
Add mushrooms and a pinch of salt and pepper to hot pot. Stir occasionally until browned, 4-6 minutes.
Transfer mushrooms to a plate. Keep pot over medium heat; no need to wipe clean.

steps.title: Start the Risotto
bullets: Add rice to hot pot. Stir occasionally until rice is toasted and opaque, 1-2 minutes.
Add 1 cup boiling water from other medium pot to pot with rice. Rice should just be covered by water.
Stir often until nearly all water is absorbed.

steps.title: Finish the Risotto
bullets: Add 1/2 cup boiling water to hot pot and stir often again until nearly all water is absorbed. Repeat this process, stirring often, 18-20 minutes.
Taste risotto as you cook, checking for tenderness. When rice has no more “bite” or crunch, it's done. There may be water left.

Remove from burner. Stir in mushrooms, cheese, softened butter (to taste), half the chives (reserve remaining for garnish), garlic salt, a pinch of pepper, creme fraiche, and mirepoix base until combined. Cover and set aside.

steps.title: Cook Scallops and Finish Dish
bullets: Place a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat and add 1 Tbsp. olive oil. Let heat, 3 minutes.
Add scallops to hot pan and cook undisturbed, 90 seconds.
After 90 seconds, stir occasionally until scallops reach a minimum internal temperature of 145 degrees, 60-90 seconds.
Remove from burner. Stir in softened Sicilian sauce (to taste) until melted and combined.
Plate dish as pictured on front of card, topping risotto with scallops. Garnish with remaining chives. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Onion and Mushroom Stroganoff Penne
RECIPES.subtitle: with croutons
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 400 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes

steps.title: Cook the Pasta
bullets: Once water is boiling, add pasta and cook until al dente, 10-12 minutes.
Remove from burner. Drain pasta in a colander/strainer, shaking to remove as much water as possible. Set aside. Reserve pot; no need to wipe clean.
While pasta cooks, continue recipe.

steps.title: Prepare the Ingredients
bullets: Cut mushrooms into 1/4" slices.
Coarsely crush croutons.
Stem thyme.
Halve and peel onion. Slice halves into thin strips.
Mince garlic.

steps.title: Cook the Mushroom-Onion Mixture
bullets: Place a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat and add 2 tsp. olive oil.
Add mushrooms, onions, garlic, 1/2 tsp. salt, and 1/4 tsp. pepper to hot pan. Stir occasionally until onions and mushrooms have browned, 10-12 minutes.
Remove from burner.

steps.title: Add the Sauce and Pasta
bullets: Return pot used to cook pasta to medium-high heat.

Add cream base, vegetable base, half the thyme (reserve remaining for garnish), half the cheese (reserve remaining for topping), pasta, and mushroom-onion mixture to hot pot. Stir to combine. Bring to a simmer.
Once simmering, stir occasionally until slightly thickened, 2-4 minutes.
Remove from burner.

steps.title: Bake Casserole and Finish Dish
bullets: Transfer pasta mixture to prepared casserole dish. Top with crushed croutons and remaining cheese.
Bake in hot oven until cheese is golden-brown, 6-8 minutes.
Carefully remove from oven.
Plate dish as pictured on front of card, garnishing with remaining thyme. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Zesty Poblano Chicken Chowder
RECIPES.subtitle: with tortilla strips
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry

steps.title: Prepare the Ingredients
bullets: Quarter lime.
Halve and peel onion. Cut halves into 1/4" dice.
Stem poblano, seed, and cut into 1/2" dice. Poblano peppers can vary in spice level; most are mild, but a few can be quite hot. Wash hands and cutting board after prepping.
Pat chicken dry and season all over with a pinch of pepper.

steps.title: Sear the Chicken
bullets: Place a medium pot over medium-high heat and add 1 tsp. olive oil.
Add chicken to hot pot and stir occasionally until browned on two sides, 4-6 minutes.
Reduce heat to medium. Transfer to a plate. Chicken will finish cooking in a later step.
Keep pot over medium heat; no need to wipe clean.

steps.title: Start the Chowder
bullets: Add 2 tsp. olive oil to hot pot.
Add onions and poblanos (use less if spice-averse). Stir often until vegetables are slightly softened, 3-5 minutes.
Stir in corn and chile and cumin rub until combined, 30-60 seconds.

steps.title: Finish the Chowder
bullets: Add chicken and any accumulated juices, 1/2 cup water, cream base, and chicken base to hot pot. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Once simmering, stir occasionally until slightly thickened and chicken reaches a minimum internal temperature of 165 degrees, 5-7 minutes.
If too thick, stir in additional water, 1 Tbsp. at a time, until desired consistency is reached.
Remove from burner. Season with a pinch of pepper.

steps.title: Finish the Dish
bullets: Plate dish as pictured on front of card, topping chowder with cheese and tortilla strips. Squeeze lime wedges over to taste. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: One-Sheet Loaded Chicken
RECIPES.subtitle: with broccoli, bell pepper, and sweet potato
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 425 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes

steps.title: Start the Vegetables
bullets: Peel and cut sweet potato into 1" dice.
Place sweet potatoes on prepared baking sheet. Toss with 1 tsp. olive oil and a pinch of salt.
Roast in hot oven, 10 minutes.
While sweet potatoes roast, continue recipe.

steps.title: Prepare the Ingredients
bullets: Cut broccoli into bite-sized pieces.
Remove stem, seeds, and ribs, and cut bell pepper into 1" dice.
Trim and thinly slice green onions.

steps.title: Add the Broccoli and Peppers
bullets: After 10 minutes, carefully remove sheet from oven.

Add broccoli, bell peppers, 2 tsp. olive oil, potato spice seasoning, garlic and parsley seasoning, and a pinch of salt to sheet. Stir to combine and push vegetables to one side. Sheet will be hot! Use a utensil.

steps.title: Add the Chicken
bullets: Pat chicken dry. Season both sides with blackening seasoning and 1/4 tsp. salt.
Place chicken on empty side of sheet and evenly top with bacon, then cheese.

steps.title: Finish Vegetables and Chicken and Finish Dish
bullets: Roast in hot oven until vegetables are tender and chicken reaches a minimum internal temperature of 165 degrees, 20-25 minutes.
Carefully remove sheet from oven and stir softened butter into vegetables until melted. Sheet will be hot! Use a utensil.
Plate dish as pictured on front of card, topping chicken with sour cream and green onions. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Pork Medallions with Mushroom Sauce
RECIPES.subtitle: and garlic mashed potatoes
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Set butter on counter to soften

steps.title: Cook the Pork
bullets: Pat pork dry and season all over with ranch seasoning and a pinch of pepper.
Place a medium non-stick pan over medium heat and add 2 tsp. olive oil. Add pork to hot pan and cook until pork reaches a minimum internal temperature of 145 degrees, 3-5 minutes per side.
Medallion thickness can vary; if you receive a thinner medallion, we recommend checking for doneness sooner. Remove from burner and transfer pork to a plate. Rest, 3 minutes.
Reserve pan; no need to wipe clean.
While pork cooks, continue recipe.

steps.title: Prepare the Ingredients
bullets: Stem mushrooms and cut caps into 1/4” slices.
Trim and thinly slice green onions on an angle, keeping white and green portions separate.

steps.title: Make the Gravy
bullets: Return pan used to cook pork to medium heat and add 2 tsp. olive oil. Add mushrooms, white portions of green onions, and a pinch of salt to hot pan. Stir occasionally until browned, 4-6 minutes.
Add 5 tsp. all-purpose flour and stir until no dry flour remains. Add demi-glace and 3/4 cup water. Bring to a simmer.
Once simmering, reduce heat to low and add pork. Gently flip and simmer until coated, 3-5 minutes.
If sauce is too thick, add water, 1 Tbsp. at a time, until desired consistency is reached. Remove from burner.

steps.title: Heat Potatoes and Finish Dish
bullets: Place another medium non-stick pan over medium heat and add 2 tsp. olive oil.
Add mashed potatoes and half the garlic salt (remaining is yours to use as you please!) to hot pan and stir vigorously until thickened and desired consistency is reached, 3-5 minutes.
Remove from burner and stir in softened butter until combined.
Plate dish as pictured on front of card, topping pork and mashed potatoes with gravy and garnishing with green portions of green onions. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: One-Pan French Onion Beef Gemelli
RECIPES.subtitle: with Swiss and mozzarella
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Preheat the broiler

steps.title: Prepare the Ingredients
bullets: Stem and mince thyme.
Halve and peel shallot. Slice halves into thin strips.
Pat steak strips dry. Coarsely chop, then separate pieces. Season all over with a pinch of salt and pepper.

steps.title: Cook the Shallots and Steak Strips
bullets: Place a large oven-safe pan over medium-high heat and add 2 tsp. olive oil.
Add shallots to hot pan. Stir occasionally until tender and slightly browned, 5-7 minutes.
Add steak strips. Stir occasionally until no pink remains and steak strips reach a minimum internal temperature of 145 degrees, 4-6 minutes.

steps.title: Add the Sauce and Pasta
bullets: Add flour and half the thyme (reserve remaining for garnish) to hot pan. Stir often until no dry flour remains.
Add 1/4 cup water, mushroom base, onion salt, garlic and parsley seasoning, a pinch of pepper, and cream base. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Once simmering, add pasta and mozzarella. Stir often until pasta is heated through and cheese is melted, 2-3 minutes.
If sauce is too thick, add additional water, 1 Tbsp. at a time, until desired consistency is reached.
Remove from burner.

steps.title: Broil Pasta and Finish Dish
bullets: Evenly top pasta with Swiss cheese.
Broil under hot broiler until cheese is melted and golden-brown, 1-2 minutes.
Don't text and broil! Keep an eye on oven as cheese may burn easily under broiler.
Carefully remove from oven. Pan handle will be hot! Use an oven mitt.
Plate dish as pictured on front of card, topping pasta with remaining thyme. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Homestyle Broccoli, Cheddar, and Chicken Soup
RECIPES.subtitle: with croutons
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry

steps.title: Cook the Chicken
bullets: Pat chicken dry and season all over with garlic pepper.

Place a medium non-stick pan over medium-high heat and add 2 tsp. olive oil. Add chicken to hot pan. Stir occasionally until golden-brown and chicken reaches a minimum internal temperature of 165 degrees, 5-7 minutes.
Remove from burner and set aside to cool.
While chicken cooks and cools, continue recipe.

steps.title: Start the Soup
bullets: Coarsely chop broccoli.
Place a medium pot over medium-high heat.
Add broccoli, cream base, cream cheese, potato spice seasoning, and 2 cups water to hot pot. Bring to a simmer, stirring occasionally.
While soup comes to a simmer, continue recipe.

steps.title: Chop the Chicken
bullets: Once cool enough to handle, transfer chicken to a clean work surface and coarsely chop.

steps.title: Finish Soup and Finish Dish
bullets: Once simmering, add chicken to hot pot. Stir occasionally until broccoli is tender and chicken is heated through, 3-4 minutes.
Remove from burner. Stir in half the shredded cheese (reserve remaining for garnish) until melted and combined.
Plate dish as pictured on front of card, topping soup with remaining shredded cheese and croutons. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Blue Cheese Sirloin Steak
RECIPES.subtitle: with Parmesan potatoes and arugula salad
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 425 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes

steps.title: Prepare the Ingredients
bullets: Place potatoes in a microwave-safe bowl and cover with a damp paper towel. Microwave covered until tender, 4-6 minutes.
While potatoes microwave, trim and thinly slice green onions.
Carefully remove potatoes from microwave.
Using the flat side of an object, press down gently to smash each potato until 1/2" thick. Reserve bowl; no need to wipe clean.
In provided tray, combine potatoes, 1 Tbsp. olive oil, 1/4 tsp. salt, and a pinch of pepper. Massage oil and seasonings into potatoes. Push to one side of tray.

steps.title: Add Steaks and Bake Meal
bullets: Pat steaks dry and season both sides with garlic salt.
Place a medium non-stick pan over medium-high heat and add 2 tsp. olive oil. Add steaks to hot pan. Sear undisturbed until browned on one side, 2-3 minutes.
Remove from burner. Transfer steaks, seared side up, to empty side of tray.
Bake uncovered in hot oven until potatoes are browned and steaks reach a minimum internal temperature of 145 degrees, 10-12 minutes.
Steak thickness can vary; if you receive a thinner steak, we recommend checking for doneness sooner. Carefully remove from oven. Stir softened butter into potatoes. Tray will be hot! Use a utensil.
Rest steaks, 3 minutes.
While meal bakes, continue recipe.

steps.title: Make Sauce, Dress Arugula, and Finish Meal
bullets: In reserved microwave-safe bowl, combine blue cheese (to taste), 1 Tbsp. water, and cream cheese. Microwave uncovered until heated through, 45-60 seconds.
While sauce microwaves, in a mixing bowl, combine arugula, half the shredded cheese (reserve remaining for garnish), a pinch of salt, and 1 tsp. olive oil. Set aside.
Carefully remove sauce from microwave and stir to combine. If too thick, add additional water, 1 tsp. at a time, until desired consistency is reached.
To serve, top steak with sauce (to taste), arugula mixture, and balsamic glaze. Slice steak, if desired. Garnish potatoes with remaining shredded cheese and green onions. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Crunchy Pesto Mozzarella Chicken
RECIPES.subtitle: with tomato-green bean medley
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 425 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes

steps.title: Start the Vegetables
bullets: Trim green beans, if necessary. Break green beans in half.
Prick tomatoes all over with a fork. If you receive one whole tomato instead, not to worry; simply core tomato, cut into 1/2" dice, and proceed with recipe instructions.
In provided tray, combine green beans, tomatoes, 1/4 tsp. salt, garlic pepper, and 2 tsp. olive oil. Gently toss to coat. Spread into an even layer. Cover tray with foil.
Bake covered in hot oven until tomatoes begin to burst, 15-20 minutes.
While vegetables bake, continue recipe.

steps.title: Add the Chicken
bullets: Pat chicken dry and season both sides with 1/4 tsp. salt and a pinch of pepper.
In a mixing bowl, combine breadcrumbs, mozzarella, and 2 tsp. olive oil.
After 15-20 minutes, carefully remove tray from oven. Push vegetables to one side of tray. Tray will be hot! Use a utensil.
Add chicken to now-empty side and top evenly with pesto, then mozzarella-breadcrumb mixture, pressing gently to adhere.

steps.title: Bake the Meal
bullets: Bake again uncovered in hot oven until vegetables are tender and chicken reaches a minimum internal temperature of 165 degrees, 20-25 minutes.
Carefully remove from oven.
To serve, top vegetables with Parmesan. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Sausage Risotto Verde
RECIPES.subtitle: with pesto and leeks
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 425 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes

steps.title: Bake the Sausage and Leeks
bullets: Place sausage in provided tray and break up into bite-sized pieces. Spread into a single layer and evenly top with leeks.
Bake uncovered in hot oven until sausage reaches a minimum internal temperature of 160 degrees, 15-18 minutes.
Carefully remove from oven.

steps.title: Start the Risotto
bullets: Carefully massage rice in bag to break up any clumps and remove from packaging.
Stir in rice, 1/4 cup water, cream base, garlic salt, and garlic pepper until combined.
Evenly top with spinach and 1 tsp. olive oil.
Bake uncovered in hot oven until spinach is wilted and rice is heated through, 10-12 minutes.
Carefully remove from oven.

steps.title: Finish Risotto and Finish Meal
bullets: Stir in pesto, softened butter, and half the cheese (reserve remaining for garnish) until combined. Butter will melt as meal bakes.
Bake again in hot oven until sauce is bubbling, 5-10 minutes.
Carefully remove from oven.
To serve, top risotto with remaining cheese and lemon juice (to taste). Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Spinach Florentine Chicken Noodles
RECIPES.subtitle: in cream sauce

ingredients.name: Fully Cooked Seasoned Diced Chicken Breast

beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 425 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes

steps.title: Prepare the Spinach
bullets: Coarsely tear spinach.

steps.title: Assemble the Meal
bullets: Drain chicken, pat dry, and separate pieces.

In provided tray, combine chicken, noodles, Italian seasoning, spinach, minced garlic and parsley, butter, half the grated cheese (reserve remaining for garnish), cream base, 1/4 tsp. salt, and a pinch of pepper. Butter will melt as meal bakes.
Spread mixture into an even layer and evenly top with shredded cheese. Cover tray with foil.

steps.title: Bake the Meal
bullets: Bake covered in hot oven until chicken and noodles are heated through, 15-20 minutes.
Carefully remove from oven. Stir in a pinch of salt until combined.
To serve, top chicken noodles with remaining grated cheese. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Truffle Butter Filet Mignon
RECIPES.subtitle: with fondant potatoes
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 425 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes

steps.title: Prepare the Ingredients
bullets: Cut broccoli into bite-sized pieces.
Peel and slice potatoes into 1" thick rounds.
Zest and halve lemon. Cut one half into wedges and juice the other half.
Pat steaks dry and season both sides with garlic pepper.

steps.title: Make the Bacon Truffle Butter
bullets: Place a medium non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add bacon to hot, dry pan. Stir occasionally until crispy, 1-2 minutes.
Remove from burner. Transfer bacon and bacon fat to a mixing bowl. Wipe pan clean and reserve.
Add softened truffle butter (to taste), softened creme fraiche, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Stir to combine. Set aside.

steps.title: Roast the Broccoli
bullets: Place broccoli, 2 tsp. olive oil, 1/4 tsp. salt, and a pinch of pepper on prepared baking sheet. Massage oil and seasonings into broccoli. Spread into an even layer.
Roast in hot oven until tender, 18-22 minutes.
Carefully remove from oven. Stir in 1 tsp. lemon zest and 1 tsp. lemon juice. Sheet will be hot! Use a utensil.
While broccoli roasts, continue recipe.

steps.title: Roast the Potatoes
bullets: Place a large oven-safe pan over medium-high heat and add 2 tsp. olive oil.
Add potatoes, 1/4 tsp. salt, and a pinch of pepper to hot pan. Sear until golden-brown, 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove from burner. Add 2 Tbsp. water, chicken base, and garlic & herb butter. Stir until combined and potatoes are coated.
Transfer pan to hot oven and roast until potatoes are tender, 15-20 minutes.
Carefully remove from oven. Pan handle will be hot! Use an oven mitt.
While potatoes roast, continue recipe.

steps.title: Cook Steaks and Finish Dish
bullets: Return pan used to cook bacon to medium-high heat and add 2 tsp. olive oil.
Add steaks to hot pan. Cook until steaks reaches desired doneness, or 4-6 minutes per side for medium/medium-well.
Steak thickness can vary; if you receive a thinner steak, we recommend checking for doneness sooner.
Remove from burner. Rest, 3 minutes.
Plate dish as pictured on front of card, topping steak with bacon truffle butter. Squeeze lemon wedges over broccoli to taste. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Fried Shallot Beef Cheddar Burger
RECIPES.subtitle: on a brioche bun
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 450 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes

steps.title: Roast the Fries
bullets: Cut potatoes into 1/2"-thick fries and pat dry.
Place fries on prepared baking sheet and toss with 2 tsp. olive oil, 1/4 tsp. salt, and a pinch of pepper. Spread into a single layer.
Roast in hot oven until golden-brown, 25-30 minutes, tossing once halfway through.
While fries roast, continue recipe.

steps.title: Prepare Ingredients and Heat Oil
bullets: Core and cut tomato into 1/4" slices.
Peel and thinly slice shallot. Keep shallot slices intact as much as possible.
Place a medium non-stick pan over medium-high heat and add 1/4 cup neutral oil. Let heat, 5 minutes.

While oil heats, combine tempura mix and 3 Tbsp. water in a mixing bowl and stir until a thin batter forms, like pancake batter. If too thick, add additional water, 1 Tbsp. at a time, until desired consistency is reached. Set aside.

steps.title: Fry the Shallots
bullets: Line a plate with a paper towel.
Add shallots to mixing bowl with tempura batter and stir until coated. Keep shallot slices intact as much as possible.
Test oil temperature by adding a pinch of batter to it. It should sizzle gently. If it browns immediately, turn heat down and let oil cool. If it doesn't brown, increase heat.
Working in batches, transfer shallots to hot oil, allowing excess batter to drip off (there should be no overlap). Cook until golden-brown, 1-2 minutes per side.
Transfer shallots to towel-lined plate. Repeat with remaining shallots.
Remove from burner.

steps.title: Cook the Patties
bullets: In another mixing bowl, combine ground beef and a pinch of salt. Form mixture into two evenly-sized patties, about 5" in diameter. Season both sides with garlic pepper.

Summertime, and the grilling is easy! To grill this burger, heat grill to medium. Follow same instructions, grilling until browned and beef reaches a minimum internal temperature of 160 degrees, 4-6 minutes per side.
Place a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add patties to hot, dry pan and cook, 4 minutes per side.
Top patties with cheese and cook until cheese is melted and patties reach a minimum internal temperature of 160 degrees, 1-2 minutes.
Remove from burner. Transfer patties to another plate. Wipe pan clean and reserve.

steps.title: Toast Buns and Finish Dish
bullets: Return pan used to cook patties to medium heat.
Add buns, cut-side down, to hot, dry pan. Toast until lightly browned, 1-2 minutes.
Remove from burner.
Plate dish as pictured on front of card, topping bottom bun with dip'n sauce, patty, tomatoes, fried shallots, then top bun. Serve BBQ sauce on the side for dipping fries. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Asiago-Pesto Stuffed Chicken
RECIPES.subtitle: with bacon Brussels sprouts
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 400 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes

steps.title: Prepare Brussels Sprouts and Make Filling
bullets: Trim stems off Brussels sprouts and halve vertically (quarter if larger than a ping-pong ball).
In a mixing bowl, combine pesto, softened cream cheese, and half the shredded cheese (reserve remaining for chicken). Set aside.

steps.title: Prepare the Chicken
bullets: Pat chicken dry.
Want a shortcut? Skip cutting and stuffing. Reserve filling, season chicken, and skip to step 3.

Place chicken on a clean cutting board. Hold knife blade parallel to the board and carefully make a lengthwise cut through the center of the meat, using your free hand to steady meat. Stop short of opposite edge of chicken so chicken remains in one piece. Open chicken as you would a book.
Divide filling evenly between chicken, placing in center. Fold chicken in half over filling. Season with 1/4 tsp. salt and 1/4 tsp. pepper.

steps.title: Sear and Roast the Chicken
bullets: Place a medium non-stick pan over medium heat and add 1 tsp. olive oil. Add chicken to hot pan. Sear until browned, 2-4 minutes on one side.
Remove from burner. Transfer chicken to prepared baking sheet, sear side up, then evenly top with remaining shredded cheese. If you skipped stuffing in step 2, top chicken evenly with filling.
Roast in hot oven until chicken reaches a minimum internal temperature of 165 degrees, 10-12 minutes.
Carefully remove from oven.
While chicken cooks, continue recipe.

steps.title: Toast the Breadcrumbs
bullets: Place a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat and add 1 tsp. olive oil.
Add breadcrumbs to hot pan and toast until lightly browned, 1-2 minutes.
Remove from burner. Transfer to a plate and set aside. Wipe pan clean and reserve.

steps.title: Cook Brussels Sprouts and Finish Dish
bullets: Return pan used to toast breadcrumbs to medium-high heat. Add 1 tsp. olive oil and Brussels sprouts to hot pan. Stir occasionally until beginning to soften, 1-2 minutes.
Add 1/4 cup water. Cover and cook undisturbed until Brussels sprouts are almost tender, 4-6 minutes.
Uncover and add bacon, 1/4 tsp. salt, 1/4 tsp. pepper, honey (to taste), and red pepper flakes (to taste). Stir occasionally until bacon is crispy and Brussels sprouts are tender, 2-3 minutes.
Remove from burner. Stir in 1 Tbsp. salted butter until melted and combined.
Plate dish as pictured on front of card, garnishing Brussels sprouts with toasted breadcrumbs. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Maple Bacon-Glazed Sirloin
RECIPES.subtitle: with zucchini and Parmesan roasted potatoes
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 425 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes

steps.title: Prepare the Ingredients
bullets: Trim zucchini ends and slice into 1/2" rounds.
Cut potatoes into 1/4" wedges and pat dry.
Pat steaks dry and season both sides with 1/4 tsp. salt and a pinch of  pepper.

steps.title: Start the Vegetables
bullets: Evenly spread cheese on a plate.
Toss potatoes with 2 tsp. olive oil, potato spice seasoning, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Place potatoes onto cheese and coat one side, pressing gently to adhere. Place potatoes on prepared baking sheet, cheese-side up, and spread into an even layer.
Roast in hot oven, 15 minutes.
While potatoes roast, continue recipe.

steps.title: Cook the Steaks
bullets: Place a medium non-stick pan over medium heat and add 1 tsp. olive oil. Add steaks to hot pan and cook until steaks reach desired doneness, or 4-6 minutes per side for medium/medium-well.
Steak thickness can vary; if you receive a thinner steak, we recommend checking for doneness sooner.
Remove from burner. Transfer steaks to another plate and cover with foil. Rest, 3 minutes.
Wipe pan clean and reserve.

steps.title: Finish the Vegetables
bullets: After 15 minutes, carefully remove baking sheet from oven.
Flip potatoes and push to one side of sheet.
Shingle zucchini on now-empty side of sheet. Sheet will be hot! Use a utensil. Evenly top with 1 tsp. olive oil, 1/4 tsp. salt, a pinch of pepper, then breadcrumbs. Spray with cooking spray.
Roast in hot oven until vegetables are browned and tender, 10-15 minutes.
While vegetables roast, continue recipe.

steps.title: Make Glaze and Finish Dish
bullets: Return pan used to cook steaks to medium heat. Add bacon to hot, dry pan and stir often until crispy, 45-60 seconds.
Reduce heat to medium-low. Add maple syrup and mustard (to taste). Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Once simmering, stir occasionally until slightly thickened, 60-90 seconds.
Remove from burner and stir in 1/2 Tbsp. salted butter until melted and combined.
Plate dish as pictured on front of card, topping steak with glaze. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Salmon with Lemon Butter Sauce
RECIPES.subtitle: and green beans and potatoes
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 425 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes

steps.title: Prepare the Ingredients
bullets: Cut potatoes into 1" wedges.
Trim ends off green beans, if necessary.
Halve lemon lengthwise. Cut one half into wedges and juice the other half.
Stem and coarsely chop parsley.
Pat salmon dry and season flesh side with a pinch of salt and pepper.

steps.title: Roast the Potatoes and Green Beans
bullets: Place potatoes on one half of prepared baking sheet and toss with 1 tsp. olive oil, half the garlic salt (reserve remaining for green beans), Parmesan, 1/4 tsp. salt, and a pinch of pepper. Spread into a single layer on their side.
Roast in hot oven, 8 minutes.

Carefully remove baking sheet from oven and flip potatoes. Place green beans on empty half of sheet and toss with 1 tsp. olive oil, remaining garlic salt, and a pinch of pepper. Spread into a single layer on their side. Baking sheet will be hot! Use a utensil.
Roast in hot oven until tender, 10-15 minutes.
While vegetables roast, continue recipe.

steps.title: Cook the Salmon
bullets: Place a medium non-stick pan over medium heat and add 2 tsp. olive oil.
Add salmon, skin-side up, to hot pan and cook until golden-brown and salmon reaches a minimum internal temperature of 145 degrees, 4-6 minutes per side.
Remove from burner. Transfer salmon to a plate and tent with foil. Wipe pan clean and reserve.

steps.title: Make the Sauce
bullets: Return pan used to cook salmon to medium-low heat. Add softened cheese spread (crumbling if necessary) and 2 Tbsp. water to hot pan and stir constantly until melted and combined, 30-60 seconds.
If too thick, add additional water, 1 Tbsp. at a time, until desired consistency is reached.
Remove from burner. Stir in mayonnaise, butter, 1 tsp. water, 1/2 tsp. lemon juice, and a pinch of salt until butter is melted and combined.

steps.title: Finish the Dish
bullets: Plate dish as pictured on front of card, topping salmon with sauce. Garnish dish with parsley and squeeze lemon wedges over to taste. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Italian Tortellini and Swiss Chard Soup
RECIPES.subtitle: with Asiago cheese bread
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Preheat the broiler

steps.title: Prepare the Ingredients
bullets: Halve any large butternut squash pieces to roughly match smaller pieces.
Stem Swiss chard and trim stalks. Cut stems into 1/2” slices on an angle and coarsely chop leaves.
Trim and thinly slice green onions on an angle, keeping white and green portions separate.

steps.title: Cook the Butternut Squash
bullets: Place a medium pot over medium heat and add 2 tsp. olive oil.
Add butternut squash and 1/4 cup water to hot pot. Stir to combine, then bring to a simmer.
Once simmering, cover and stir occasionally until water is almost completely evaporated, 5-6 minutes.

steps.title: Add the Swiss Chard
bullets: Uncover; add 2 tsp. olive oil, white portions of green onions, Swiss chard stems, half the lemon n herb seasoning (reserve remaining for broth), and pinch of salt and pepper to hot pot. Stir often until vegetables are tender and slightly browned, 2-3 minutes.
Add 1 tsp olive oil, Swiss chard leaves, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Stir often until leaves are wilted, 2-3 minutes.

steps.title: Add the Broth and Tortellini
bullets: Add flour to hot pot and stir often until no dry flour remains. Add cream base, vegetables base, grated cheese, remaining lemon n herb seasoning, 1/4 tsp. salt, a pinch of pepper, and 2 1/2 cups water. Stir to combine and bring to simmer.
One simmering, add tortellini and stir often until al dente, 3-4 minutes.
Remove from burner.

steps.title: Broil Cheese Bread and Finish Dish
bullets: Separate French roll and halve lengthwise. Evenly spread cut sides of rolls with 1 Tbsp. softened butter and top with shredded cheese.
Place roll halves on prepared baking sheet. Place under hot broiler until cheese is slightly browned, 3-4 minutes.
Don't text and broil! Keep an eye on oven as cheese bread may burn easily under broiler.
Carefully remove from broiler.
Plate dish as pictured on front of card, garnishing soup with green portions of green onions and crispy onions. Cut cheese bread into thirds, if desired. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Hot Honey Crispy Chicken
RECIPES.subtitle: and sweet Dijon Brussels sprouts
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 425 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes

steps.title: Prepare the Ingredients
bullets: Trim stems off Brussels sprouts and halve vertically (quarter if larger than a ping-pong ball).
Mince garlic.
Pat chicken dry and season both sides with 1/4 tsp. salt and a pinch of pepper.

steps.title: Prepare the Chicken
bullets: In a mixing bowl, combine breadcrumbs, blackening seasoning, garlic, and 1 tsp. olive oil.
Place chicken on one half of prepared baking sheet. Spread mayonnaise evenly on one side of chicken, then top with breadcrumb mixture, pressing gently to adhere.

steps.title: Roast the Chicken and Brussels Sprouts
bullets: Place Brussels sprouts on empty half of baking sheet and toss with 2 tsp. olive oil, 1/4 tsp. salt, and a pinch of pepper. Spread into a single layer on their side.
Roast in hot oven until Brussels sprouts are tender and lightly browned and chicken reaches a minimum internal temperature of 165 degrees, 17-20 minutes.
Carefully remove from oven.
While chicken and Brussels sprouts roast, continue recipe.

steps.title: Make the Hot Honey
bullets: In another mixing bowl, combine honey and hot sauce (to taste). Set aside.

steps.title: Finish the Dish
bullets: Plate dish as pictured on front of card, topping Brussels sprouts with dressing and drizzling hot honey (to taste) over chicken. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Marsala Mushroom-Smothered Pork Chop
RECIPES.subtitle: with garlic green beans
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry

steps.title: Prepare the Ingredients
bullets: Cut mushrooms into 1/4" slices.
Mince garlic.
Pat pork chops dry and season both sides with pot roast seasoning, 1/4 tsp. salt, and a pinch of pepper.

steps.title: Cook the Pork Chops
bullets: Place a medium non-stick pan over medium heat and add 1 tsp. olive oil.
Add pork chops to hot pan. Cook until golden-brown and pork reaches a minimum internal temperature of 145 degrees, 3-5 minutes per side.
If seasoning starts to burn, lower heat. Pork thickness can vary; if you receive a thinner chop, we recommend checking for doneness sooner.
Remove from burner. Transfer pork to a plate and tent with foil. Rest, 3 minutes.
Reserve pan; no need to wipe clean.
While pork chops cook, continue recipe.

steps.title: Cook the Green Beans
bullets: Trim green beans, if necessary.
Place a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat and add 1 tsp. olive oil.
Add half the garlic (reserve remaining for sauce) to hot pan. Stir occasionally until aromatic, 30-60 seconds.
Stir in green beans, 1/4 tsp. salt, and a pinch of pepper until coated.
Add 2 Tbsp. water, cover, and reduce heat to medium. Stir occasionally until green beans are tender, 8-10 minutes.
If green beans need more time, add 2 Tbsp. water and stir occasionally, 1-3 minutes.
Remove from burner.

steps.title: Make the Sauce
bullets: Return pan used to cook pork chops to medium-high heat and add 1 tsp. olive oil.
Add mushrooms, remaining garlic, and a pinch of salt to hot pan. Stir occasionally until lightly browned, 3-4 minutes.
Add wine and cook until mostly evaporated, 30-60 seconds.
Stir in demi-glace, 2 Tbsp. water, and any accumulated juices from resting pork. Bring to a boil.
Once boiling, remove from burner. Stir in 1/2 Tbsp. butter until melted and combined, 30-60 seconds.

steps.title: Finish the Dish
bullets: Plate dish as pictured on front of card, topping pork chop with sauce. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Philly Cheesesteak Beef Mac
RECIPES.subtitle: with two cheeses
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Bring 8 cups water and 2 tsp. salt to a boil in a large non-stick pan

steps.title: Cook Pasta and Prepare Ingredients
bullets: Once water is boiling, add pasta to hot pan. Cook until al dente, 10-12 minutes.
Remove from burner. Reserve 1 cup pasta cooking water. Drain pasta in a colander/strainer and set aside. Wipe pan clean and reserve.
While pasta cooks, remove stem, seeds, and ribs, and cut bell peppers into 3/4'' dice.
Halve and peel onion. Cut halves into 1/2'' dice.
Coarsely tear sliced cheese.

steps.title: Cook the Vegetables
bullets: Return pan used to cook pasta to medium-high heat and add 1 Tbsp. olive oil.
Add bell peppers, onions, garlic salt, and 1/4 tsp. pepper to hot pan. Stir occasionally until tender, 8-10 minutes.
Transfer vegetables to plate and keep pan over medium-high heat; no need to wipe clean.

steps.title: Cook the Ground Beef
bullets: Add ground beef, garlic pepper, and a pinch of salt to hot pan. Break up meat until no pink remains and beef reaches a minimum internal temperature of 160 degrees, 4-6 minutes.
Drain any excess liquid, if desired.

steps.title: Add the Sauce
bullets: Add cream base, beef base, half the pasta cooking water (reserve remaining for adjusting), 1/4 tsp. salt, and sliced cheese (to taste) to hot pan.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.

steps.title: Add Pasta and Cheese and Finish Dish
bullets: Once simmering, add pasta and vegetables to hot pan. Stir often until pasta is heated through and sauce is slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes.
If too thick, add remaining pasta cooking water, 1 Tbsp. at a time, until desired consistency is reached.
Evenly top pasta with shredded cheese. Cover and cook until cheese is melted, 1-2 minutes.
Remove form burner.
Plate dish as pictured on front of card. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Herb-Crusted Chicken
RECIPES.subtitle: with broccoli and Parmesan mashed potatoes
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry

steps.title: Prepare the Ingredients
bullets: Cut broccoli into bite-sized pieces.
In a microwave-safe bowl, combine mashed potatoes, cream cheese, and 1/2 Tbsp. plain butter. Stir vigorously and set aside. Cream cheese and butter will melt as potatoes heat.
Pat chicken dry and season both sides with Italian seasoning and a pinch of salt and pepper.

steps.title: Cook the Chicken
bullets: Place a medium non-stick pan over medium heat and add 2 tsp. olive oil.
Add chicken to hot pan and cook until browned and chicken reaches a minimum internal temperature of 165 degrees, 5-7 minutes per side.
Remove from burner. Transfer chicken to a plate and tent with foil.
While chicken cooks, continue recipe.

steps.title: Cook the Broccoli
bullets: Place another medium non-stick pan over medium heat and add 1 tsp. olive oil.
Add broccoli, half the garlic salt (reserve remaining for potatoes), and 1/4 cup water to hot pan. Cover and cook until water is almost completely evaporated, 4-6 minutes.
Uncover, and stir occasionally until tender, 2-3 minutes.
Remove from burner.

steps.title: Heat Mashed Potatoes and Finish Dish
bullets: Cover mashed potatoes with a paper towel. Microwave covered until heated through, 2-3 minutes, stirring once halfway through.
Carefully remove from microwave and uncover. Stir in shredded cheese, remaining garlic salt, and garlic and parsley seasoning until thoroughly combined.
Plate dish as pictured on front of card, topping chicken with garlic and herb butter. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Creamed Spinach Cavatappi
RECIPES.subtitle: with toasted Asiago breadcrumbs
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Preheat the broiler

steps.title: Cook the Spinach
bullets: Place a large oven-safe pan over medium-high heat.
Add 3 cups water, cream base, and seasoned salt to hot pan. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Once simmering, add pasta and cook until al dente, 10-12 minutes.
While pasta cooks, continue recipe.

steps.title: Cook Pasta and Prepare Spinach and Make Ricotta Topping
bullets: Coarsely chop spinach.
In a mixing bowl, combine ricotta, pesto, and a pinch of salt. Set aside.

steps.title: Add the Sauce and Pasta
bullets: Add spinach and minced garlic and parsley to hot pan. Stir until spinach is wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Add half the Asiago (reserve remaining for topping), and a pinch of pepper and stir until sauce is thickened, 2-3 minutes.
Remove from burner.

steps.title: Broil Pasta and Finish Dish
bullets: Evenly top pasta with dollops of ricotta topping, then remaining Asiago, breadcrumbs, and red pepper flakes (to taste).
Transfer to hot broiler and broil until breadcrumbs are browned, 1-2 minutes.
Don't text and broil! Keep an eye on oven as breadcrumbs may burn easily under broiler.
Carefully remove from broiler. Pan handle will be hot! Use an oven mitt.
Plate dish as pictured on front of card. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Creamy Chicken Caesar Skillet
RECIPES.subtitle: with Parmesan green beans
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry

steps.title: Toast the Breadcrumbs
bullets: Place a medium non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add 1 Tbsp. butter to hot pan. Stir constantly until melted, 20-30 seconds.
Stir in breadcrumbs  until golden-brown, 1-2 minutes.
Remove from burner. Transfer breadcrimbs to a plate. Wipe pan clean and reserve.
While breadcrumbs toast, continue recipe.

steps.title: Prepare the Ingredients
bullets: Trim green beans, if necessary.
Pat chicken dry. Season all over with garlic pepper and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Cook the Green Beans
bullets: Place a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat and add 2 tsp. olive oil. Add green beans to hot pan and cook, 1 minute.

After 1 minute, add 1/4 cup water, garlic salt, and a pinch of pepper. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, cover and stir occasionally until water is almost completely evaporated and green beans are tender, 6-8 minutes.
If green beans need more time, add 2 Tbsp. water, cover, and stir occasionally, 1-3 minutes.
Stir in half the dressing and half the cheese (reserve remaining of both for garnish) until combined, 1-2 minutes
Remove from burner.
While green bean cooks, continue recipe.

steps.title: Cook the Chicken
bullets: Return pan used to toast breadcrumbs to medium-high heat add 1 tsp. olive oil. Add chicken to hot pan. Stir occasionally until golden-brown and chicken reaches a minimum internal temperature of 165 degrees, 5-7 minutes.
Remove from burner.
Plate dish as pictured on front of card, topping green beans with chicken. Garnish with remaining dressing, remaining cheese, and breadcrumbs. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Italiano Parmesan Chicken
RECIPES.subtitle: with broccoli carbonara pasta
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 425 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes

steps.title: Prepare the Broccoli
bullets: Break broccoli into bite-sized pieces.
Place broccoli in provided tray. Toss with 1 tsp. olive oil and a pinch of salt and pepper. Push to one side.

steps.title: Add Chicken and Bake Meal
bullets: Evenly spread breadcrumbs and half the grated cheese (reserve remaining for pasta) on a plate.
Pat chicken dry. Season both sides with 1 tsp. olive oil and garlic and parsley seasoning. Transfer chicken to plate with breadcrumb mixture, pressing gently to adhere on one side.
Add chicken to empty side of tray, breadcrumb side up, and spray with cooking spray.
Bake uncovered until broccoli is tender and chicken reaches a minimum internal temperature of 165 degrees, 20-25 minutes.
Carefully remove from oven.

steps.title: Make Pasta and Finish Meal
bullets: In a microwave-safe bowl, combine pasta, cream base, cream cheese, bacon, remaining grated cheese, and 2 Tbsp. water. Microwave uncovered until pasta is heated through, 2-3 minutes.
Carefully remove from microwave. Stir in broccoli until combined.
To serve, top chicken with softened butter. Garnish pasta with shredded cheese. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Sun-Dried Tomato Chicken Penne
RECIPES.subtitle: with panko
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 425 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes

steps.title: Prepare the Ingredients
bullets: Pat chicken dry.
In provided tray, combine pasta, chicken, pesto, cream base, potato spice seasoning, and 3 Tbsp. water. Spread into a single layer.

steps.title: Add the Toppings
bullets: Evenly top with shredded cheese, grated cheese, panko, then 1 tsp. olive oil.

steps.title: Bake the Meal
bullets: Bake uncovered in hot oven until panko is golden-brown and chicken reaches a minimum internal temperature of 165 degrees, 25-30 minutes.
Carefully remove from oven. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Italian Sausage and Marinara Cream Pasta
RECIPES.subtitle: with peas
