Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 425 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes

steps.title: Prepare the Ingredients
bullets: In provided tray, combine pasta, cream base, half the marinara (remaining is yours to use as you please!), peas, and tomatoes. Spread into an even layer.

steps.title: Add the Sausage
bullets: Evenly top pasta with sausage, breaking into small pieces.
Evenly top pasta mixture with a pinch of salt and pepper.

steps.title: Bake the Meal
bullets: Bake uncovered in hot oven until sausage reaches a minimum internal temperature of 160 degrees, 25-27 minutes.
Carefully remove tray from oven and stir to combine.
To serve, top pasta with cheese and red pepper flakes (to taste). Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Chicken and Broccoli Alfredo
RECIPES.subtitle: with crispy onions
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 425 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes

steps.title: Prepare the Chicken and Broccoli
bullets: Spray provided tray with cooking spray.
Pat chicken dry. Season all over with half the garlic salt (reserve remaining for broccoli) and a pinch of pepper.
Combine broccoli and chicken in prepared tray. Toss with remaining garlic salt, garlic pepper, and 1 tsp. olive oil.

steps.title: Add the Pasta and Sauce
bullets: Bake uncovered in hot oven, 15 minutes.
Chicken will finish cooking in a later step.
Carefully remove tray from oven.
Add cream base, pasta, cheese, and mirepoix base. Stir to combine. Tray will be hot! Use a utensil.

steps.title: Finish the Meal
bullets: Bake again uncovered in hot oven until broccoli is tender, pasta is heated through, and chicken reaches a minimum internal temperature of 165 degrees, 15-18 minutes.
Carefully remove tray from oven and stir to combine.
To serve, top pasta with crispy onions. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Meaty Mushroom and Bolognese Risotto
RECIPES.subtitle: sauce includes beef and pork
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 425 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes

steps.title: Start the Mushrooms
bullets: Place mushrooms in provided tray. Toss with 2 tsp. olive oil and a pinch of salt. Spread into an even layer.
Bake uncovered in hot oven, 15 minutes.
Carefully remove from oven and drain any excess liquid, if necessary. Tray will be hot! Use caution/a utensil.

steps.title: Assemble Risotto and Bake Meal
bullets: Carefully massage rice in bag to break up any clumps.

Stir  garlic salt, a pinch of pepper, bolognese sauce, half the shredded cheeses (reserve remaining for garnish), cream cheese, Italian seasoning, beef base, and rice into tray until combined. Cover with foil. Cream cheese will melt as meal bakes. Tray will be hot! Use a utensil/caution.
Bake covered in hot oven until rice is heated through, 15-20 minutes.
Carefully remove from oven and discard foil. Stir to combine. Tray will be hot! Use a utensil/ caution.
While meal bakes, continue recipe.

steps.title: Toast Breadcrumbs and Finish Meal
bullets: In microwave-safe bowl, combine breadcrumbs and 1 tsp. olive oil. Microwave uncovered until golden-brown, 60-90 seconds, stirring once halfway through.
Carefully remove from microwave.
To serve, top risotto with remaining cheeses and breadcrumbs. Bon appétit!

RECIPES.title: Creamy Garlic & Herb Chicken
RECIPES.subtitle: with pesto mashed potatoes
beforeYouCook: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and warm water before cooking and after handling raw meat or seafood
Remove all produce from any packaging or constraints, then thoroughly rinse and pat dry
Turn oven on to 425 degrees. Let preheat, at least 10 minutes

steps.title: Assemble the Meal
bullets: In one provided tray, combine zucchini and a pinch of salt and pepper. Spread into an even layer.
Pat chicken dry. Season both sides with 2 tsp. olive oil, garlic pepper, and 1/4 tsp. salt. Place chicken in second provided tray.

steps.title: Bake the Meal
bullets: Bake zucchini tray uncovered in hot oven until tender 15-20 minutes.
Bake chicken tray uncovered until chicken reaches a minimum internal temperature of 165 degrees, 20-25 minutes.
Carefully remove from oven. Stir lemon n herb seasoning into zucchini until combined. Tray will be hot! Use a utensil.
While meal bakes, continue recipe.

steps.title: Make Sauce, Heat Mashed Potatoes, and Finish Meal
bullets: In a microwave-safe bowl, combine minced garlic and parsley, cream base, grated cheese, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Microwave uncovered until cheese is melted, 45-60 seconds.
Carefully remove from microwave and stir to combine.
Place mashed potatoes in another microwave-safe bowl. Microwave uncovered until heated through, 2-3 minutes.
Carefully remove from microwave and stir in butter until combined.
To serve, top chicken with sauce. Bon appétit!

ingredients.name: Steamed Garlic and Parsley Green Beans
ingredients.canonical: steamed garlic and parsley green beans

steps.title: MICROWAVE INSTRUCTIONS
bullets: Remove sleeve. Peel back film halfway to vent. Remove any garnishes. Place tray on microwave safe plate. Microwave on HIGH for 2 minutes. If needed, stir and continue to heat in 30 second intervals until desired temperature is reached. Let stand for 1 minute. Remove from microwave - be careful as product will be hot. Remove film, add any garnishes and serve.

steps.title: CONVENTIONAL OVEN INSTRUCTIONS
bullets: Preheat oven to 325°F. Remove sleeve. Remove film. Remove any garnishes. Place tray on an oven safe cookware and bake for 30 minutes. Remove from oven - be careful as product will be hot. Add any garnishes and serve.
